examples: Overlay applies to a PSGC-coded jurisdiction.
predicate_registry.migration_behavior: legacy jurisdiction labels require steward-reviewed jurisdiction IDs
non_examples: Topic is loosely relevant to a country.
predicate_registry.validation_rule: from_id and to_id must be valid VTN IDs and jurisdiction evidence must exist

examples: Architecture is broader than architectural accessibility.
predicate_registry.migration_behavior: legacy taxonomy parent links require accepted steward mapping
non_examples: A source document mentions a concept.
predicate_registry.validation_rule: must not replace provenance or vague relatedness

examples: Equal-force requirements cannot be composed automatically.
predicate_registry.migration_behavior: legacy related/conflict notes enter review queue
predicate_registry.validation_rule: must produce a structured conflict set before resolution

examples: A zoning limit constrains a floor-area concept.
predicate_registry.migration_behavior: legacy shallow relatedness requires operator review
non_examples: A rule merely cites a source.

examples: A candidate mapping is supported by an evidence span.
predicate_registry.migration_behavior: DEFINED_BY and SUPPORTED_BY map to provenance only
non_examples: Evidence edge counted as semantic quality.
predicate_registry.validation_rule: provenance edges must not be counted as semantic applicability

examples: A national code governs an applicability context.
predicate_registry.migration_behavior: legacy authority names require source-rights registry rows
non_examples: A source is useful background reading.
predicate_registry.validation_rule: force class and source rights row must exist

examples: A concept has lifecycle or domain facet values.
predicate_registry.migration_behavior: legacy tags map only through controlled facets
predicate_registry.validation_rule: facet family and value must be controlled vocabulary entries

examples: A Vitruvius concept maps to a classification reference.
predicate_registry.migration_behavior: legacy standard codes require source-rights review
non_examples: Copying protected table content into the registry.
predicate_registry.validation_rule: source-rights class must allow metadata crosswalk

examples: A concept is narrower than its accepted parent.
predicate_registry.migration_behavior: legacy child links require accepted steward mapping
non_examples: A source document belongs under a topic.
predicate_registry.validation_rule: must match an accepted hierarchy pair or generated inverse

examples: A subsystem is part of a larger building system.
predicate_registry.migration_behavior: legacy containment labels require composition review
non_examples: A rule applies to a system.

examples: A rule requires a permit action or system feature.
predicate_registry.migration_behavior: legacy obligation text requires operator extraction
non_examples: A rule supports a concept definition.
predicate_registry.validation_rule: required action or item must be explicit

examples: A newer release supersedes an older release.
predicate_registry.migration_behavior: legacy edition labels require temporal review
non_examples: Two sources disagree without temporal evidence.
predicate_registry.validation_rule: effective date evidence must be recorded
